Bonesaw Cycling Collective Summer Tuesday Ride

Minneapolis, MN · Phillips · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Bonesaw Cycling Collective Summer Tuesday Ride is a social group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It rolls last Tuesday of the month at 7:00 pm from Cepro Site / Parque Monarca (Midtown Greenway at 10th Ave S). About 12–15 miles, 10–12 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–12 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bonesawcyclingcollective the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bonesaw Cycling Collective Summer Tuesday Ride group ride

A monthly summer social ride from the Greenway to the Sabo Bridge. 12 to 15 miles at 10–12 mph with a mid-ride stop. Guest groups like Biking with Baddies and the bike polo club help lead. Bring lights and a lock.
